$description: Hand-authored Tier-2 role bindings. Roles are intent (primary/secondary/danger/success/warning/info/muted); each is a layman-readable pointer at a palette or signal seed. The visual editor rebinds role -> palette without touching components. Three primaries (main/alt/deep) ship as the brand floor — blue, deep purple, deep blue. Same shape as accent: { main, glow, fill, fg } with -alt- / -deep- sibling variants where roles need siblings.

primary.$description: Lead brand role. Three independent primaries — main (brand blue, hue 240), alt (deep purple), deep (deep blue). CTAs MUST be blue per locked product requirement #6 (project_model_loader_requirements.md): 'Blue tint — stop shipping black-and-white UI · CTAs must be BLUE.' Rebind by swapping the $value reference; components keep working.

main.$description: Primary lead — brand blue (hue 240), stop 500: light labels hold their contrast on it, which they do not on the owner's brighter #3ea4ea (accent.blue.main).

alt-main.$description: Primary alt — deep purple (purple ramp stop 700).

deep-main.$description: Primary deep — deep blue (brand-azure ramp stop 700).

secondary.$description: Secondary brand surface — paired with primary. Default: the owner's purple.

danger.$description: Destructive action / failure state. Bound to signal.error.

success.$description: Positive outcome / confirmed state. Bound to signal.success.

warning.$description: Caution / degraded state. Bound to signal.warning.

fg.$description: Foreground / on-warning text — dark text on bright warning.

info.$description: Informational / neutral status update. Bound to signal.info.

muted.$description: Low-emphasis surface + text role. Default: text.muted + surface.subtle.

fg.$description: Foreground for content on a muted surface.
